name: Mujteknify Chat for WooCommerce
author: mujteknify

sections.description:
Mujteknify Chat for WooCommerce adds a customizable floating WhatsApp chat button to your store, making it easy for customers to reach you instantly.

Features

  • 💬 Floating chat widget
  • 📱 Customizable welcome message
  • ⚙️ Position control (left/right)
  • 📊 Basic dashboard statistics
  • ✅ Customer opt-in system

Pro Version

Upgrade to our Pro version for advanced features:

  • 🛒 Abandoned cart recovery
  • 📢 Bulk messaging campaigns
  • ⚡ Automation rules & templates
  • 📊 Advanced analytics dashboard
  • ✅ Priority support & updates

Learn more about Pro features

External Services

This plugin connects to the WhatsApp Business API (via Facebook Graph API) to enable WhatsApp messaging functionality.

Service Used: WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Facebook Graph API)

What data is sent:
* WhatsApp Business Phone Number ID
* WhatsApp recipient phone numbers
* Message content and templates
* Customer name (when available)

When data is sent:
* When customers click the chat widget to initiate a conversation
* When store sends messages (Pro version only for automation features)

User Consent:
* Customers must opt-in via checkout checkbox to receive marketing messages (Pro version)
* Chat widget usage implies consent for customer-initiated conversations

Service Provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
* Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/about/privacy
* WhatsApp Business API Documentation: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp
* WhatsApp Business Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-terms

Note: You must have a Meta Business account and WhatsApp Business API access to use this plugin. The Lite version only provides the chat widget (customer-initiated). API integration for automated messages requires the Pro version.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/whatswoo-lite/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Navigate to WhatsWoo > Settings to configure your chat widget
  4. Get your API credentials from Meta Business Manager
  5. Save and enjoy!
sections.faq:
Do I need a business account?

Yes, you need a Meta Business account with access to the Cloud API.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes! WhatsWoo Lite fully supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes, you can customize the welcome message and widget position.
